recent.text: Biggest defensive play of game for #Pelicans was Trey Murphy stopping Darius Garland, who seemed caught in between trying to shoot a 3 or trying to draw a foul. Ball was gathered in near sideline by Herb Jones, who sank a free throw for 105-101 lead with 9 seconds left https://t.co/onXzkChH1L
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Trey Murphy, Zion Williamson score 25 points each as #Pelicans post 105-104 road victory at Clippers, their first away win since beating Memphis on Nov. 2. Murphy six steals, makes critical defensive stop in final seconds up 3. Postgame wrap: https://t.co/j5GiNajSZH https://t.co/fok7Ctute2
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: #Pelicans get a win at Clippers 105-104. After giving up 139 on same floor earlier this month, a much better defensive performance equals a victory. Trey Murphy 6 steals, Jeremiah Fears 3 steals
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Pelicans beat Clippers 105-104, snapping 4-game losing streak. Just 3rd clutch win of season. Nola owned lane with 64-34 edge in points in paint. Zion Williamson: 25 PTS, 7 REB, 5 AST Trey Murphy: 25 PTS, 6 STL (career high), 3 3s Jordan Poole: 16 PTS Derik Queen: 11 PTS, 8 REB
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: #Pelicans have been coming up with some key hustle plays tonight. Herb Jones scrambles to save a ball, leading to Zion dishing to Murphy for a dunk. Those two have combined for 48 pts on 19/30 shooting. NOLA 98-92 at 3:14
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Good things have seemingly happened all night when Zion Williamson has touched the ball -- either he's scored or he's found an open teammate. Pelicans lead Clippers 98-92 with 3:14 left.
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: There have been multiple testy exchanges tonight between #Pelicans and Clippers, understandable as both teams try to end losing streaks. Poole, Queen, Strus, Dunn involved in minor confrontations
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Pelicans lead Clippers 80-77 after three. Much cleaner frame than previous two. Nola dominating paint (41-34 rebounding, 46-26 PTS in paint). Zion Williamson: 23 PTS (10-14 FG), 6 REB Trey Murphy: 17 PTS, 6 STL (career high) Jordan Poole: 13 PTS, 2 3s Yves Missi: 10 REB, 4 AST
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: He's made 16 of 19 field goal attempts in the two games at Clippers this month (shot 9/9 on Nov. 8)
